Majda is an experienced leader with over 20 years of experience in operational and HR leadership within complex international environments. She joins from Sodexo, where she served as CHRO for France and Europe, as well as Global EVP Lead. Her extensive background includes nearly 15 years at IKEA, where she held diverse roles ranging from HR Country Manager to Store Manager and Head of E-commerce. A specialist in organizational transformation and leadership, she is also the founder of the podcast &#8220;Hors Cadre RH&#8221; and the movement &#8220;\u00c9lan.&#8221;<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/majdavincent.com\/biographie\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\">[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146999&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;213374&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;169513&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><b data-path-to-node=\"2\" data-index-in-node=\"0\">GETEC appoints Dr. Alexander Jawad as Chief Human Resources Officer<\/b><br \/>\n<strong>(December, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">GETEC Group (Germany, sustainable energy solutions) has appointed Dr. Alexander Jawad as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) and member of the Executive Committee, effective December 1, 2025. Reporting to CEO Pierre-Alain Graf, Dr. Jawad will lead GETEC&#8217;s pan-European people strategy, focusing on talent management and cultural transformation to support the company\u2019s growth. He brings extensive international experience from senior HR roles at IKEA and Johnson Controls. He holds a strong academic background in labour law and an MBA, making him a specialist in navigating complex organizational and regulatory environments.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.getec-energyservices.com\/en\/media\/news\/getec-appoints-dr-alexander-jawad-as-new-chief-human-resources-officer-.php\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\">[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;147000&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;459760&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;605749&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><strong>M.J. Eriksson appoints Thomas Thors\u00f8e as HR Director<br \/>\n(December, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">M.J. Eriksson A\/S (Denmark&#8217;s largest earthworks and civil engineering contractor) has appointed Thomas Thors\u00f8e as HR Director, overseeing HR, Communications, and Occupational Health &amp; Safety. Thomas joins with the ambition to modernize MJE\u2019s organizational structure through a strong leadership culture and targeted employer branding. His focus will be supporting the company&#8217;s growth by strengthening recruitment, leadership development, and a robust safety culture. He aims to position MJE as a highly visible and attractive workplace for future generations, centering on professional pride and cross-organizational cohesion.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/posts\/thomas-thors%C3%B8e_nyt-job-pr-1-december-og-jeg-activity-7379742055448739840-e8Im?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAADVugDkBZCasAFN-Vzd6P9MGbgfM1taiV-g\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\">[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][\/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;147001&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;272945&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;115161&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><strong>Sapiens appoints Dr. Ernesto Marinelli as Chief People Success Officer<br \/>\n(December, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">Sapiens International Corporation (Germany, software solutions for the insurance industry) has appointed Dr. Ernesto Marinelli as Chief People Success Officer. Ernesto is a global executive with a 30-year career focused on driving high-impact transformations across sales, product, and development organizations. He joins from Aareon (an Advent-backed company), where he served as Chief People Officer. His extensive background also includes serving as Senior Vice President and Head of Global People Success Services at SAP. Combining digital fluency with commercial acumen, he specializes in building scalable, people-first strategies to fuel growth in technology-driven sectors. He holds a PhD in German Linguistics from the University of W\u00fcrzburg.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/sapiens.com\/about\/leadership\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;147002&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;160421&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;307296&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><strong>SULO Group appoints Carine Escribe as Group CHRO<span class=\"\"><br \/>\n(December,<\/span><span class=\"\"> 2025)<\/span><\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">SULO Group<span class=\"\"> (France\/Global,<\/span><span class=\"\"> circular economy and waste management) has appointed <\/span>Carine Escribe<span class=\"\"> as Group Chief Human Resources Officer.<\/span><span class=\"\"> In her new role,<\/span><span class=\"\"> she also oversees <\/span>Internal Communication, Health &amp; Safety (H&amp;S), and ESG<span class=\"\"> strategy.<\/span><span class=\"\"> Carine joins the group&#8217;s Global Executive Committee during a period of significant leadership transition and international expansion,<\/span><span class=\"\"> including the recent appointment of Thierry Koskas as President.<\/span><span class=\"\"> She brings over <\/span>24 years of experience<span class=\"\"> from <\/span>Engie, where she held various senior HR leadership and transformation roles. Her focus at SULO is to guide the organization through its next stage of development, supporting its mission to turn waste into sustainable resources for cities and communities.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/posts\/carine-escribe-ceo-drh-international-leader-humain-impactant-digital-ai_careerupdate-newchapter-internationalhumanresources-activity-7402026242943758336-Smd_?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAADVugDkBZCasAFN-Vzd6P9MGbgfM1taiV-g\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\">[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;147003&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;115116&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;158508&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><strong>WS Audiology appoints Asger Bjerre as Chief People Officer<br \/>\n(December, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">WS Audiology (Denmark, hearing healthcare) has appointed Asger Bjerre as Chief People Officer and member of the management team, effective December 1, 2025. He succeeds Nicolai Jensen, who is stepping down after ten years with the company. Asger joins from Becton Dickinson &amp; Company (BD), where he most recently served as Senior Vice President of Culture and Talent. With a strong track record in driving global organizational culture and talent development, he will lead the group&#8217;s people strategy as it continues to innovate in the hearing healthcare sector.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.wsa.com\/press-release\/asger-bjerre-appointed-wsa-chief-people-officer\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\">[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][\/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/1&#8243;][vc_custom_heading uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;172978&#8243;]November 2025[\/vc_custom_heading][vc_separator sep_color=&#8221;&#8221; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;195815&#8243;][\/vc_column][\/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;147004&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;488716&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;938220&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><strong>Akuo appoints Caroline Roynette Benoit as Chief Human Resources Officer<br \/>\n(November, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">Akuo (France, global independent producer of renewable energy) has appointed Caroline Roynette Benoit as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Joining during a transformational period following the group&#8217;s acquisition by Ardian, Caroline will drive the people strategy to support Akuo\u2019s ambitious growth targets, including its goal to reach 5 GW of capacity by 2030. She brings over 25 years of experience in international HR leadership, most recently serving as Chief People Officer at Albioma (a KKR portfolio company). Her extensive background includes leadership roles at Sulzer, where she was Global Head of HR for the Water and Industry unit, as well as senior positions at Hutchinson and General Electric. She specializes in M&amp;A integration, organizational redesign, and leadership development in complex, multicultural environments. She is an alumna of Universit\u00e9 Paris Dauphine and Universit\u00e9 Panth\u00e9on Sorbonne.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/posts\/caroline-roynette-benoit-a8baa67_jai-le-plaisir-de-vous-annoncer-que-je-commence-activity-7409922109017214976-MZ72?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAADVugDkBZCasAFN-Vzd6P9MGbgfM1taiV-g\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\">[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146972&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;930223&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;139098&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><strong>ROSEN appoints Alice Heezen-Dokianos as Chief Human Resources Officer<br \/>\n(November, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">ROSEN (Global\/Switzerland, technology-enabled asset integrity solutions) appoints Alice Heezen-Dokianos as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Based in Zurich, Alice joins the executive team at a pivotal time as the company accelerates its transformation agenda across its 4,000-strong global workforce. She is a seasoned HR executive with over three decades of experience leading large-scale organizational redesigns and cultural reinvention. She joins from Synthomer, where she served as CHRO, and previously held the same role at Trinseo, where she specialized in executive architecture and DEI evolution during major global acquisitions. Her extensive background also includes leadership positions at ADAMA Ltd., Fiberweb, BG Group, Rexam, and Korn Ferry (Hay Group).<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/hrtoday.in\/alice-heezen-dokianos-appointed-as-chief-human-resources-officer-at-rosen\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146971&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;130798&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;731785&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><strong>ZEDRA welcomes Aoife Habben as Chief People Officer<br \/>\n(November, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">ZEDRA (Global, corporate services, wealth, and fund solutions) has appointed Aoife Habben as Chief People Officer. Joining at a pivotal time of global expansion, Aoife will drive the people agenda and nurture an inclusive, high-performing culture across the firm&#8217;s international offices. She brings over 20 years of experience in high-growth environments, having previously held senior HR leadership roles at Amazon and GE. Most recently, she served as a senior HR leader at a private equity-backed fintech firm. Currently based in London, she will relocate to ZEDRA\u2019s Jersey office in early 2026. Her appointment follows a series of strategic additions to the Executive Committee aimed at supporting long-term sustainable growth.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.zedra.com\/news\/zedra-welcomes-aoife-habben-as-chief-people-officer\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][\/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146993&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;901038&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;104433&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><b data-path-to-node=\"2\" data-index-in-node=\"0\">Brenntag appoints Francis Bracke-Schr\u00f6der as Chief HR Officer<\/b><br \/>\n<strong>(November, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">Brenntag (Germany, chemicals and ingredients distribution) has appointed Francis Bracke-Schr\u00f6der as Chief HR Officer (CHRO). Francis joins the group with extensive experience in human resources and organizational transformation across several global sectors. Most recently, she held leadership roles at AkzoNobel, where she focused on preparing for high-level HR responsibilities. Her career highlights include managing the integration of TNT colleagues into FedEx, as well as previous management and HR roles at Philips and Bluewater Engineering. Known for her expertise in integration strategy, change management, and talent acquisition, she originally transitioned into HR from a background in psychology, building a career defined by leading teams through complex hypergrowth and organizational shifts.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/posts\/francis-bracke-schr%C3%B6der-58461b2_when-i-finished-university-i-felt-it-was-activity-7392595483652812800-0SnJ?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAADVugDkBZCasAFN-Vzd6P9MGbgfM1taiV-g\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p>[\/vc_column_text][vc_single_image][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146994&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;106576&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;175380&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><b data-path-to-node=\"2\" data-index-in-node=\"0\">Brooks Macdonald appoints Andy Robinson as Chief People Officer<\/b><br \/>\n<strong>(November, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">Brooks Macdonald (UK, investment management) appoints Andy Robinson as Chief People Officer (CPO) and a member of the Executive Committee. Reporting directly to CEO Andrea Montague, Andy will oversee all aspects of the firm\u2019s people strategy\u2014including talent, culture, and organizational capability\u2014to support the &#8220;Reignite Growth&#8221; strategy. He brings over 30 years of global human capital leadership experience, joining from Alantra, where he served as Global Head of Human Capital. His previous executive roles include Head of HR at Jupiter Asset Management, Henderson Global Investors, and UniCredit, as well as early career experience at GSK.<\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\"><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.brooksmacdonald.com\/resources\/news\/brooks-macdonald-appoints-andy-robinson-chief-people-officer\">More information<\/a><\/strong><\/p>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"4\">[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146995&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;105658&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;144631&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5 data-path-to-node=\"2\"><b data-path-to-node=\"2\" data-index-in-node=\"0\">Dipharma Francis S.r.l. appoints Barbara Lorenzin as Global Head of People &amp; Culture<\/b><br \/>\n<strong>(November, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p data-path-to-node=\"3\">Dipharma Francis S.r.l. (Italy, global pharmaceutical CDMO) appoints Barbara Lorenzin as Global Head of People &amp; Culture. Anna brings over 20 years of diverse HR generalist experience across various organizations and industries, including more than 10 years leading globally dispersed People teams within Berlin&#8217;s vibrant founder-led tech ecosystem. She has held leadership roles across the USA, EMEA, and APAC and has over three years of executive experience reporting directly to a CEO. Anna will collaborate with CEO Pascal Keller-Bossart to support the company through its current phase of dynamic change and growth, succeeding Ute Maria Zankl.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/posts\/anna-richardson-a7896013_newbeginnings-cybersecurity-activity-7345727614667374593-OZf8?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAADVugDkBZCasAFN-Vzd6P9MGbgfM1taiV-g\">More information<\/a><\/strong>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][\/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146792&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;184167&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;106067&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>Fresenius Kabi appoints Tanja Bender as Chief Human Resources Officer<br \/>\n(July 1, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>Global healthcare company Fresenius Kabi (Germany) appoints Tanja Bender as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Tanja transitions into the permanent CHRO role after having served as the Interim Chief HR Officer for several months. She is committed to supporting Fresenius Kabi&#8217;s mission of being &#8220;Committed to Life&#8221; and will collaborate with CEO Pierluigi Antonelli and the Executive Leadership Team to advance people practices that drive the company&#8217;s transformation into an even more competitive and impactful organization.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/posts\/tanjabender_newbeginnings-hr-interimchro-activity-7335168321031454720-YLuj?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAADVugDkBZCasAFN-Vzd6P9MGbgfM1taiV-g\">More information<\/a><\/strong>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146793&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;632985&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;133543&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>Logisfashion SA appoints Irene F\u00e9lez Monter as Chief Human Resources Officer <\/strong><br \/>\n<strong>(July, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>Logisfashion SA (Spain, global operations), a logistics and transport company specializing in the fashion sector, appoints Irene F\u00e9lez Monter as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Irene brings over 15 years of HR experience across diverse sectors, including Logistics, Retail, Technology, and Textile Industry. In her role, she will focus on change management, designing and implementing policies to build an attractive, motivated, and productive workforce. Her expertise includes conflict resolution, people development, and negotiation.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/in\/irene-f%C3%A9lez-monter-15605217\">More information<\/a><\/strong>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146794&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;130440&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;873228&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>Star-shl appoints Carmen van Casteren as HR Manager \/ CHRO<br \/>\n(July, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>Star-shl (Netherlands), a market leader in medical and laboratory diagnostics, appoints Carmen van Casteren as HR Manager \/ CHRO. Operating across the regions of North Brabant, Zeeland, and South Holland, Star-shl is a key innovation leader in healthcare. Carmen will oversee the human resources strategy for the organization, which provides comprehensive services including imaging, functional testing, and runs one of the Netherlands&#8217; most advanced, highly automated laboratories in Rotterdam.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/in\/carmen-van-casteren-31b12822\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][\/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146795&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;610812&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;140726&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>NACOS Marine appoints Undine Peters as Chief People Officer <\/strong><br \/>\n<strong>(July, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>NACOS Marine (Germany, global operations), a newly established standalone maritime technology company following a carve-out from W\u00e4rtsil\u00e4, appoints Undine Peters as Chief People Officer (CPO). Undine will lead the people and culture strategy for the organization, which operates in 10 countries with over 730 employees. She brings more than 15 years of experience in People &amp; Culture roles, specializing in Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Organizational Development within fast-paced, global environments, with a focus on growth and stability.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/posts\/activity-7345783142961627139-A85E?utm_source=share&amp;utm_medium=member_desktop&amp;rcm=ACoAADVugDkBZCasAFN-Vzd6P9MGbgfM1taiV-g\">More information<\/a><\/strong>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146796&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;135835&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;606377&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>Travelex appoints Jeroen Bongers as CHRO Netherlands <\/strong><br \/>\n<strong>(July, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>Travelex (Netherlands, global operations) appoints Jeroen Bongers as CHRO Netherlands, adding this leadership role to his existing position as Head of HR Europe (a role he has held since November 2023). Jeroen is a knowledgeable and internationally experienced HR professional with a strong track record of successfully managing change in complex and ambitious companies. He is recognized for his operational, hands-on approach to handling significant organizational changes, including upscalings, downsizings, and establishing business operations in new countries, and for building effective HR teams.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/in\/jeroen-bongers\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146797&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;398471&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;641421&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>PwC appoints Sophie Mouhieddine as Chief Human Resources Officer<br \/>\n(July, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>PwC (France, Consulting\/Professional Services) appoints Sophie Mouhieddine as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Sophie brings over 25 years of experience as an HR Director, specializing in international recruitment and talent development policies. She is an expert in creating strong employer brands, guiding organizational transformations, and structuring the HR function. Her background includes working with major international brands in customer-focused sectors such as consulting (BT Consulting &amp; SI), hospitality (Groupe Flo), and specialized retail (Sephora, Aigle, Maisons du Monde).<\/p>\n<p><a href=\"https:\/\/www.pwc.fr\/fr\/contacts\/s\/sophie-mouhieddine.html\"><strong>More information<\/strong><\/a>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][\/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146798&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;138959&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;643636&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>Sarens appoints Thijs Lombaert as Chief Human Resources Officer<br \/>\n(July, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>Sarens (Belgium, global operations), the reference in crane rental services, heavy lifting, and engineered transport, appoints Thijs Lombaert as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Thijs is tasked with leading the global HR strategy and aligning the company&#8217;s human capital with its strategic goals\u2014ensuring the right talent is in the right place at the right time. He moves into this executive position after serving as the Group C&amp;B\/HRIS\/HRO Manager for six years (July 2019 \u2013 July 2025) within Sarens.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/in\/thijs-lombaert-21698244\/\">More information<\/a><\/strong>[\/vc_column_text][\/vc_column][vc_column width=&#8221;1\/3&#8243;][vc_single_image media=&#8221;146811&#8243; media_width_percent=&#8221;100&#8243; uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;209677&#8243;][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=&#8221;267967&#8243;]<\/p>\n<h5><strong>Nedap appoints Jan-Willem Bouwmeester as Chief People Officer<br \/>\n(July, 2025)<\/strong><\/h5>\n<p>Nedap (Netherlands, technology\/solutions provider) appoints Jan-Willem Bouwmeester as Chief People Officer (CPO). A passionate Industrial &amp; Organizational Psychologist, Jan-Willem is focused on unlocking the full power of talented humans and transforming human potential into human capital. He brings a strong track record of building people and organizational capabilities across various sectors, with deep expertise in global talent management, leadership development, DE&amp;I, performance management, and HR Technology.<\/p>\n<p><strong><a
